title: ON THE IMPACT OF TEMPORAL REPRESENTATIONS ON METAPHOR DETECTION

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of metaphor detection models using static versus decade-specific temporal word embeddings to evaluate how language evolution and time-specific representations impact word meaning.

Analyzing qualitative predictions of the metaphor detection models across different text genres (e.g., news vs. academic) to identify if word representations in specific domains are skewed or biased toward their metaphorical meanings rather than literal ones.
